today.heading: The deepening gold — midsummer's quiet zenith
today.intro: June ninth. The garden reaches its fullest expression — lilies open wide, tulips hold their chalices to the long afternoon. In this season of abundance, the light itself seems to thicken, pouring like honey over every petal and leaf. The solstice approaches, and with it, the year's most luminous pause: the moment when day refuses to end, and the world glows from within.

visualAsset.description: Impressionist lily garden at summer dusk — deep reds and soft pinks, brushstroke sky fading to gold

moon.label: I. The Moon
moon.heading: The weight of borrowed light
moon.intro: What does it mean to glow without burning? The Moon answers each night: receive completely, return everything, hold nothing back. This is not diminishment — it is the deepest form of generosity. Selene crossed the sky in her silver chariot, asking nothing of the sun she mirrored, teaching that reflection itself is a kind of faithfulness.

philosophy.label: II. The Waves
philosophy.heading: What the wave forgets it is
philosophy.intro: The ego is a wave insisting on its own outline. For one bright instant it crests, certain of its separateness — then dissolves back into the depth that never left it. This is not tragedy. The sea does not mourn the wave. To stop performing individuality is not to disappear but to arrive, finally, at the substance beneath the shape.

gita.label: III. The Battlefield
gita.heading: The geometry of surrender
gita.intro: Between two armies, with arrows nocked and drums pounding, the deepest wisdom in human literature was spoken — not in stillness but in the heart of chaos. The Gita's radical invitation: do not withdraw from the world to find truth. Immerse yourself completely, act with full commitment, and release your grip on what the action yields.

shiva.label: IV. The Dance
shiva.heading: Where silence becomes sound
shiva.intro: A single beat on the damaru and the universe begins — not as metaphor but as literal truth. Shiva's dance is every atom's movement, every star's orbit, every breath drawn and released. The Tandava does not distinguish between dancer and dance, between the drum's vibration and the silence that contains it.

art.label: V. The Canvas
art.heading: The unseen architecture of beauty
art.intro: Beauty happens in the space between — between eye and horizon, between hand and canvas, between one breath and the next. A sunflower conspires with the dawn to turn light into living gold; a lily transforms still water into sky. The impressionist knew what the mystic knows: nothing is owned, nothing is fixed. Every act of seeing is an act of creation.
